verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (SoC), and a downloadable machine-readable web API spec such as OpenAPI is not a meaningful axis for silicon. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself ships such a spec. Qualcomm's AI Hub and SDKs are separate developer services, not this product, and the OpenAPI probes on qualcomm.com all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
